hooks.name: keep-tasks-md-in-sync
hooks.description: When implementation files change, remind the agent to tick matching checkboxes in .kiro/specs/resurrect/tasks.md.

action.prompt: A source file under src/ was just saved. Check .kiro/specs/resurrect/tasks.md. If the saved change completes any unchecked task (or a clear sub-bullet), mark those checkboxes [x]. Do not invent new tasks. Keep the rest of the file unchanged.

hooks.name: check-spec-drift
hooks.description: After API or type changes, check that design.md and tasks.md still describe the shipped surface.

action.prompt: A types or API route file changed. Compare it to .kiro/specs/resurrect/design.md and tasks.md. If the code drifted from the written contracts (request/response shapes, ReceiptKind values, error codes), update the spec docs to match reality in plain language. Do not rewrite working code just to match an outdated sentence.
